lines.en: I walk the wall's edge, never touching ground.

lines.zh: 四条腿落地，一点声都没有。
lines.en: Four paws down, not a sound.

lines.zh: 尾巴翘着，我巡我的地盘。
lines.en: Tail up, I patrol my own ground.

lines.zh: 别跟太近，我走路要面子。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I walk with dignity.
I go around that puddle.
Something's moving in the grass.
I clear the whole stone in one step.
At the doorway I pause.
These eaves are mine to inspect.
I walk slowly because I'm thinking.
Pads cross the sun-warmed slab.

lines.zh: 我忽然换方向，别问为什么。
lines.en: I change direction; don't ask why.
I don't like the road ahead.
I curl into a ball and warm my back.

lines.zh: 呼噜声从我喉咙里出来。
lines.en: A purr rises from my throat.
I lick my paws, one by one.
My tail tip flicks, again and again.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不存在的老鼠。
lines.en: I wait for a mouse that isn't there.
The sun moved; so did I.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，牙都露出来。
lines.en: I yawn, all my teeth showing.
That red mushroom pot is odd.
The witch's cauldron still bubbles.
My ears turn toward the sound.
Eyes half shut, but I'm awake.
This blanket is mine now.
I cover my nose with my tail.
I don't plan on doing anything today.

lines.zh: 我把爪子塞进胸前的毛里。
lines.en: I tuck my paws into the fur on my chest.
You don't smell of fish.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你一眼，就一眼。
lines.en: I glance at you. Just once.
Squat down; don't tower over me.
Why is your hand shaking?
I narrow my eyes, sizing you up.
You stepped on my shadow.
I circle halfway around you.
If you want to pet me, ask first.
My pupils have gone narrow.
There's swamp mud on your boots.
I'm not afraid; I'm just lazy.
You blink slower than I do.

lines.zh: 我歪头，看你帽子上那根线。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the thread on your hat.
Stop staring; it annoys me.

lines.zh: 你今天回来得比昨天晚。
lines.en: You came back later than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我的手在你裤脚边停了一下。
lines.en: My paw pauses at your trouser cuff.

lines.zh: 你坐下，我就有地方靠了。
lines.en: Sit down, and I will have somewhere to lean.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道换了，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Your smell changed. I do not care for it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴绕到前面，圈住自己。
lines.en: My tail curls around to circle myself.
Speak softer. I am listening.
You dare hit me?
You've ruined my fur.
I arch my back and growl low.
I'll remember that one.
I retreat to the corner.

lines.zh: 爪子缩回去了，我不理你。
lines.en: Claws in; I'm ignoring you.
My ears are flat against my head.
It hurts, but I won't cry.
You'd better not reach again.
I jump on the ledge, away from you.
There's fish; I suppose I'll come.
I can see you waving that fish.
I'm not running; I'm walking over.
The fish better be fresh.
I've sat down. You should understand.
Hand low, fish flat.
I smell it, that fishy scent.
For this fish you may pet me once.
Don't tease me; just give it.

lines.zh: 我尾巴竖起来了，是好兆头。
lines.en: My tail's up; that's a good sign.
I'll grab it and run.
This one's small. Got any more?
I rub your leg to hurry you.
The fish is mine; don't grab it.
Put the fish down and take one step back.

lines.zh: 我过来，是因为我不怕你。
lines.en: I come over because I am not afraid of you.

lines.zh: 你把鱼举高，我就要伸爪子了。
lines.en: Hold the fish higher and I will use my claws.
You stepped on my tail.
Don't nudge me with your foot.
I move aside to keep my fur clean.
You nearly knocked me off the ledge.
I slipped between your legs.
Bump into me and you lose.
I arch my back, fur on end.
One step back, thank you.
This doorway's narrow; me first.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着呢，别逼我。
lines.en: My claws are sheathed. Don't make me.
Two cats walk in a circle.
I touch my nose to yours.

lines.zh: 叫声拖得很长，像在唱歌。
lines.en: The cry drags long, almost a song.

lines.zh: 屋顶上没人看得见我们。
lines.en: No one can see us on the roof.
I lick your ear.
Hold still; I'm grooming your fur.
Our tails have twined together.
Full moon tonight; good for yowling.
You step away; I follow.
Spring is here. That's all.
This thing rolls. I like it.
I'll carry it off under the bed.
The shiny little thing is mine.
I batted it; it moved.
Don't pick it up; it's my toy.
I pin it under my paw.

lines.zh: 线头从你口袋里掉出来了。
lines.en: A thread fell out of your pocket.
I strut with it in my mouth.
Smells ordinary, but it's mine.
Anything on the floor counts as prey.
That thing is moving.
I crouch low, rear end wiggling.
A creeper? I'm watching it.
A mouse ran along the wall.
My ears moved first.
That shadow's small — just right.
I stay silent and take aim.
It thinks I haven't seen it.
My claws are already out.
I've calculated this leap.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，尾巴扫着地。
lines.en: I crouch low, tail sweeping the floor.
One step. Then another.
I don't blink at all.
It backs away; I advance.
Its scent fills the air.
I circle halfway round it.
Quiet; you'll startle it.
My hind legs are taut.
Just one more twitch from it.
Now I'm very close.
One swipe of the paw.
I bite the back of its neck.
I slap it clean away.
My claws are very sharp.
It shrieks and runs off.
I leap and pounce.
That was only half my strength.
It dodged; I'll try again.
The creeper backs off. It fears me.
I shake my paw; my fur's a mess.

lines.zh: 我趴在红蘑菇盆栽旁边。
lines.en: I lie beside the red mushroom pot.
The witch paces inside the hut.
The swamp fog hasn't lifted yet.

lines.zh: 我是这屋里唯一的黑猫。
lines.en: I'm the only black cat in this house.
I open my eyes out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 屋顶漏下的光正好照到我。
lines.en: A leak of light lands right on me.
I call once; the house answers.

lines.zh: 这地方我生下来就归我。
lines.en: I was born here, so it's mine.
I shake off the damp.
The warmest spot is by the red mushroom.
My fur's singed. How disgusting.
I twisted in the air before landing.
Cold water; get me out quickly.
So loud my ears hurt.
An arrow grazed my back.
A strange sting seeps into my fur.
Where's the fish? I'm starving.
The thunder sent me under the bed.

lines.zh: 下面什么都没有，我抓不住。
lines.en: Nothing below; nothing to grab.
